description: This script generates PEM files from certificate data, converting ASCII to DER format and creating various test PEM files with different certificate structures and invalid contents.

methods.name: Ascii2Der
methods.description: Converts ASCII text to DER format using the ascii2der external tool.

methods.name: MakePemBlock
methods.description: Creates a PEM formatted block with headers and base64-encoded DER data.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Generates a PEM file from given text, converting it to DER and wrapping in PEM format.
